    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "file": "xmlIO.c",
      "function": "xmlEscapeText",
      "line": 332,
      "var": "repl",
      "code": "repl = tempBuf;",

    },
    {

      "file": "xmlIO.c",
      "function": "xmlEscapeText",
      "line": 362,
      "var": "repl",
      "code": "memcpy(out, repl, replSize);",
      "role": "sink",
      "note": "memcpy reads replSize bytes through repl after tempBuf is out of scope, producing the stack-use-after-scope."

    "sink": {
      "file": "xmlIO.c",
      "function": "xmlEscapeText",
      "line": 362,
      "operands": ["repl", "replSize"],
      "relation": {"op": "gt", "left": "replSize", "right": "0"}
    },
    "propagation": [
      {
        "from": {"file": "valid.c", "function": "xmlValidateElement", "line": 6094, "operands": ["attr->children"]},
        "to": {"file": "tree.c", "function": "xmlNodeListGetStringInternal", "line": 1478, "operands": ["node->content", "flags"]},
        "type": "data",
        "via": ["xmlNodeListGetString(doc, attr->children, 0)", "xmlNodeListGetStringInternal(list, escape, flags)", "node->content"]
      },
      {
        "from": {"file": "tree.c", "function": "xmlNodeListGetStringInternal", "line": 1478, "operands": ["node->content", "flags"]},
        "to": {"file": "xmlIO.c", "function": "xmlEscapeText", "line": 362, "operands": ["repl", "replSize"]},
        "type": "data",
        "via": ["xmlEscapeText(node->content, flags)", "tempBuf", "repl", "replSize"]
      }
    ]
  }
